sloka: पीठे कार्ष्णायसे च एनम् निषण्णम् कृष्ण वाससम् ।प्रहसन्ति स्म राजानम् प्रमदाः कृष्ण पिन्गलाः ॥२-६९-१४॥
transliteration: pīṭhe kārṣṇāyase ca enam niṣaṇṇam kṛṣṇa vāsasam ।prahasanti sma rājānam pramadāḥ kṛṣṇa pingalāḥ ॥2-69-14॥

translations.english: In the dream, I beheld my father clad in black clothes and resting on a seat made of iron and the women in dark and brownish complexion laughing at him.
